experience.text_you: Your sense of direction and your emotional needs are closely joined, so what you are drawn to usually also settles you. This gives you a whole-hearted, all-in quality, though it can be hard to step outside yourself or take in a very different point of view.
experience.text_they: Their sense of direction and their emotional needs are closely joined, so what they are drawn to usually also settles they. This gives them a whole-hearted, all-in quality, though it can be hard to step outside themselves or take in a very different point of view.

guidance.text_you: Before making an important decision, consider both where you want to go and what you will need emotionally to follow through.
guidance.text_they: Before making an important decision, consider both where they want to go and what they will need emotionally to follow through.
